heroSummary:
Grades 1–12 start the 2027–28 WCS school year with a half day Monday, August 9. The last student day is a half day Thursday, May 25, 2028. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Winter Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is March 13–17. Students return for a full day January 3.

The current WCS Student School Calendar lists 177 instructional days but does not include a separate first day for Pre-K, Early Childhood and Kindergarten, grade-specific early-release or late-start dates, conferences or grading-period dates. Those details are not included until WCS publishes them.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Williamson County Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–12 begin with a half day Monday, August 9, 2027. The current WCS Student School Calendar does not list a separate first full day or an opening date for Pre-K, Early Childhood or Kindergarten.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of WCS in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 25, 2028, and WCS marks it as a half day. The graduation window runs May 25–28.

calendarFaqs.q: When do WCS students return after Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return for a full day Monday, January 3, 2028. Winter Break for students is December 20–31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Has WCS published 2027–28 early-release and late-start dates?
calendarFaqs.a: WCS has not published 2027–28 early-release or late-start dates, so the 2026–27 schedule should not be carried forward.

Not in the current one-page Student School Calendar. WCS lists 83 instructional days in the first semester and 94 in the second, but the current file does not include quarter-end, progress-report or report-card dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Is March 7, 2028 a school day in WCS?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official Student School Calendar lists the Presidential Primary on March 7 as No School.
